summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Churvox Batch 4: SMS system, Calendar scheduling, and SMS trigger buttons. All 14 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI features verified including SMS page, calendar daily overview, job/invoice SMS buttons, and logo size update.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

passed_tests: GET /api/sms/balance returns balance and low_credit flag
GET /api/sms/packs returns 3 credit packs (100/$10, 500/$45, 1000/$80)
POST /api/sms/buy-credits with 100 pack adds 100 credits
POST /api/sms/buy-credits with invalid pack returns 400
POST /api/sms/send sends mock SMS and deducts 1 credit
GET /api/sms/history returns list of sent messages
POST /api/sms/send with on_the_way type works
POST /api/sms/send with invoice_reminder type works
POST /api/jobs with scheduled_date for calendar display
GET /api/jobs returns jobs with scheduled_date for calendar
Job detail has client_id for SMS lookup
POST /api/sms/send with job_id fills template with job data
POST /api/sms/send with invoice_id fills template with invoice data
SMS page loads at /sms route with balance, packs, send button, history
SMS link appears in sidebar navigation under 'More' section
Buy credits works (click pack -> balance increases)
Send SMS dialog opens with phone, type selector, optional job/invoice linking
Send SMS deducts 1 credit and shows in history
Calendar page at /calendar shows month grid with job dots on days with jobs
Calendar daily overview appears below grid when day is selected
Clicking job in calendar daily overview navigates to /jobs/:id
Calendar month navigation (prev/next) works
Calendar shows 'X jobs this month' count subtitle
Job detail page has Quick SMS card with 'On the Way' and 'Reminder' buttons (employer only)
Invoice detail page has 'SMS Reminder' button when invoice status is 'sent'
Logo is bigger in sidebar (h-24 for lg size)
seed_data_creation: Test data created during API tests (jobs, invoices, SMS logs). SMS credits purchased during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Churvox Batch 4 is complete. Features added: (1) SMS system with balance tracking, credit packs (100/$10, 500/$45, 1000/$80), send SMS dialog, message history. SMS delivery is MOCKED - no real provider. (2) Calendar page with month grid, job dots on scheduled days, daily overview with job cards, click-to-navigate to job detail. (3) Quick SMS buttons on Job detail page ('On the Way', 'Reminder') for employer only on non-completed jobs. (4) SMS Reminder button on Invoice detail page for 'sent' status invoices. (5) Logo size updated to h-24 for lg size. All Batch 1-3 features remain intact.

mocked_apis.sms_delivery: POST /api/sms/send - mock SMS delivery, deducts 1 credit, logs to DB, no real Twilio/provider
